title: The disappeared
goal: I can explain what a forced disappearance was and give the figures with their sources, using según.

items: I can explain what a forced disappearance was and give a figure with its source.
I can say what the authorities answered when families asked.
I can give the CONADEP figure and the figure of the human-rights organisations, each with its source.
I can report what a commission or the authorities said with según and decían que.
I can use the new words for the disappeared, victims and survivors.
